batting.name: Ishan Kishan
batting.dismissal: c D Pretorius b RA Jadeja

batting.name: SA Yadav
batting.dismissal: c MS Dhoni b MJ Santner

batting.name: TH David
batting.dismissal: c AM Rahane b TU Deshpande

batting.name: T Stubbs
batting.dismissal: c RD Gaikwad b SSB Magala

batting.name: AM Rahane
batting.dismissal: c SA Yadav b PP Chawla

balls.text: Pretorius nails the wide yorker. Shokeen can't touch it. He has asked for a review, but it's a legal delivery
lifted over mid-off for four more. Vital runs for Mumbai. Pretorius misses the yorker. Shokeen puts this full-toss away
on-pace wide yorker from Pretorius. Lands beyond the tramline
another slower bouncer outside off, Shokeen swings for the hills once again. Pretorius watches a top edge fly over Dhoni's head
slower bouncer outside off, hauled away to deep midwicket
slower ball, but inside the tramline, as Shokeen swings and misses
Pretorius goes for the wide yorker, too wide from Pretorius
skewed over Magala at short third for four. 114ks cutter on off, Shokeen swings to the leg side and gets four over short third
fullish and on off, whipped away to deep square leg
back of a length, brushes the pad and rolls away to short fine leg
back of a length and on off stump, punched away to the right of Gaikwad at mid-off
full and outside off, another slower ball, which is hacked away to deep midwicket
slower offcutter outside off, chipped into the leg side. Good comeback from Magala after a tough initiation into the IPL
yorker on the stumps, driven down to long-on
very full and on the stumps, driven down to long-off
short of a good length and outside off, seems like an on-pace delivery, which is cracked away on the back foot to sweeper cover
slower bouncer outside off, Shokeen flashes and misses
on a length and outside off, slapped away through the line to deep cover
back of a length and cutting into off stump, nurdled away through square leg
slower ball, full and outside off, knocked to mid-off on the front foot

6,4,6,and out! Deshpande is pumped once again. He has David holing out to Rahane at deep midwicket. Offcutter into the pitch, Deshpande hides it away from David who fetches it and ends up dragging the ball to the outfielder
pitched-up delivery outside off once again. David goes bang bang bang. He shuffles across off, gets closer to the ball and smites it over extra-cover
shorter and wider of off, possibly a slower ball, chopped away to the left of sweeper cover. Senapati can't haul it back in. The result is four. Placed between the two sweepers on the off side
slot ball from Deshpande. Overpitched and outside off, David lines it up and launches it straight over Deshpande's head. Bam!
shorter and outside off, chopped away through point
Dropped by Gaikwad this time. He runs in from long-off and dives forward, but the ball pops out. Full and outside off, David lofts it in the air and gets away

Maiden IPL wicket for Sisi. Welcome to the IPL. He takes down his SEC team-mate. Excellent tag-team work at the boundary. Pretorius takes the overhead catch with both hands at the edge of the long-off boundary. He then loses his balance and topples beyond the boundary, but has the presence of mind to lob the ball back to Gaikwad who is in the field of play. Slower full ball from Magala, he takes it away from the swinging arc, Stubbs can only slice it in the air
pretty full and sliding into off stump, David whips it away to deep midwicket
Stubbs backs away to Magala. The bowler chases the moving batter with a full-toss, which is hit down to long-on
banged in short and outside off, better length and variations from Magala. Flapped away into the leg for a single
Magala nails the yorker, on the stumps, squeezed down the ground for a single
on a length and outside off, 104.1ks slower ball. Stubbs delays his shot and pats it to point
flighted outside off and breaks away, driven to wide long-off. Another good shift from Santner. He ends with 2 for 28 in his four overs
skids into middle, chopped away on the back foot through the cover-point region
Santner hangs it up on the air, 78ks, gets it to drop and turn past off stump as David swishes and misses
wide on the crease, this arm ball is hastily jabbed to the covers
looped up on off and turns away, Stubbs checks his drive and scoops it in front of Pretorius at extra-cover
tossed up and breaks away outside off, pushed away to sweeper cover
short and hides it away from the reach of Stubbs. He flashes and misses once again. The camera pans out to Bravo in the dugout. Pretorius is doing the job Bravo used to do so well on the field now
short and bounces up outside off, Stubbs flashes and misses
short and wide of off, David gets on top of the bounce and flays it away to sweeper cover
full-toss outside off, driven up to extra-cover
whipped away from the stumps to deep midwicket
full and floated on the pads, clipped away through midwicket

Jadeja has snagged another left-hander. Umpire Gaffney's finger goes up. Varma challenges the on-field out decision. Even quicker and fizzes off the surface, breaks in to beat the inside edge and strike the front pad below the knee-roll. It would've crashed into leg stump. Varma has to depart
pushed through on leg stump, flat and quick once again. Varma drops down to one knee and sweeps it over long leg for six
Varma hangs back, opens the face and pushes to cover
back of a length and fired into the top of off, David punches a single down to long-off
fuller and on middle and leg, forward and clipped through midwicket
arm ball, speared into the pads, almost 100ks, nicked away wide of short third
another slower cutter into the pitch, David is too early into the shot. Plinked down to long-on
slower ball, full and hides it away from the reach of Varma, 109ks, forced down to long-off
another off-pace delivery from Pretorius, but this is another off-side wide
another slower ball, which is much closer to the off stump, inside-edged back to the bowler
off-side wide
full and wide of off, throws his bat at ball and gets an inside edge past leg stump
pitched up and outside off, driven through the line but straight to mid-off
short and on middle and leg, punched down to wide long-on on the back foot
fuller and turns back in, whipped off the stumps through midwicket
Varma backs away and exposes all three stumps. Darted on the top of middle, chopped away to point
chipped in the air but to the left of Jadeja to long-off
pushed through on middle and leg, clipped away through midwicket region
chopped on the back foot to point
this is a beauty from Santner! Looped up and breaks back in. Breaks through the defences of David, but just misses the stumps. Santner has his hands on his head. Bounces over middle
pushed through outside off, Varma stretches out and splices a sweep to fine leg
shorter and wider of off, rare bad ball from Santner. Varma latches onto it. He leans back and cuts it away through backward point
arm ball from Santner, he hikes his pace and gets it to skid into middle, punched down to long-on
tossed up slower and into the pads, clipped through midwicket

Thumps the pad and given out lbw. Varma chats with Arshad and MI decide against a review. Santner gets it to straighten enough from left-arm around and hit the pad in line with middle. The ball lobs off the pad to slip. Great reflexes from Rahane there
works the wicket-to-wicket ball that gives almost no time for the batter to set up down to long-on
a hint of width that time, allowing Arshad to free the arms and whack it down the ground. But its too close to Jadeja and he's in form right now
shifts the weight back and whips the flatter delivery on middle through midwicket
stays around the wicket to the left-hander for a flatter ball on middle and leg, it's worked off the back foot through midwicket

Jadeja holds onto this return catch. Pushed through outside off, on a fuller length, drilled back to Jadeja. The bowler was originally looking to take evasive action or rather throws his hands up in self defence. But he clings onto the return catch in the end. Jadeja and Santner have turned it around for CSK at the Wankhede
shorter and outside off, chopped off the back foot to point
darted on middle and leg, quietly played back to Santner
edged but to the right of slip for four. On a length and sliding across off from left-arm around, Varma wafts at it and gets it away past Rahane
heaved away to deep midwicket. Dug in short on the stumps, pulled away by Green
back of a length and turning into middle and leg, clipped away through backward square on the back foot

Dhoni thinks he has his man. Not given out caught behind. Dhoni calls for a review almost immediately. Has SKY nicked it? Pushed through flatter and quicker, skidding down the leg side. SKY shapes for a sweep. Seems like SKY has gloved this behind to Dhoni. UltraEdge detects a spike. Another low score for SKY
back of a length and into middle and leg, whisked down to long-on on the back foot
skidding into middle and leg, worked away to the right of the bowler
tossed up on middle and leg, clipped away to wide long-on

Holes out to long-on. Jadeja strikes with his fourth ball. Digs it short, angling across off stump, Kishan dares to pull against the angle. He was aiming midwicket, but ends up mis-hitting it to Pretorius at long-on. Jadeja has been taken down by left-handers in the recent past, but this time he takes down Kishan at the Wankhede
down the track and knocked down to long-on for a single as Jadeja bowls into the pitch
darted shorter and sliding across off stump, slashed away on the back foot to sweeper cover
on the pads, clipped away towards deep square leg
better length from Magala. Hits a heavy length and outside off, jabbed towards extra-cover, where Santner makes a sprawling save
just short of a yorker length on off, stabbed away to mid-off
sliced over Santner at extra-cover. Fullish and outside off, the ball turns in Kishan's hands as he slices it over the top
Magala keeps missing his length on IPL debut. Slot ball on off, Kishan gets underneath the length and cracks it over mid-on for four more
spanked straight of mid-off. Magala cops punishment for going too full once again. This full-toss is put away down the ground
pitched up and angling across off, Kishan picks it up and whips it away in the gap at midwicket
flatter and faster on middle and leg, Santner cramps Kishan once again. Short-armed to wide long-on
darted on the pads, turned away through square leg
Santner gives this more air outside off, hint of turn. Green stays leg-side of the ball and spanks it straight of wide long-off
Kishan backs away, Santner follows him and keeps him to a single down to long-on
worked away through the leg side for a single
forced down to long-on

Terrific delivery from Deshpande. He is pumped. Knocks over the off bail. On a back of a length, angling in, skidding in to breach the defences of Rohit. It straightens fairly late off the seam to square up Rohit and hit the top of off and middle. The bail landed about 5 yards short of the boundary at deep third, says Matt Roller from Wankhede
Deshpande hits a heavy length once again, on leg stump, worked through square leg on the back foot
fullish and on middle, Kishan presses forward and dinks it to point with an open face
sharp inducker from Deshpande, on a hard length, cramps Kishan for room. He hops and might have eked out an inside edge onto the thigh pad
back of a length and veering into the hips, tucked away towards long leg
scythed over point for six. Dug in short and wide of off, Rohit latches onto it and shows more intent. Struck flat and hard over point
full and wide of off, swings away even further, 139ks, Rohit has a crack at it even though it's away from the body. Slices a thick outside edge down to deep third
another hip-high short ball on leg stump, Magala gets away with that. Flapped away only as far as long leg
Magala goes shorter and outside off, but not short enough. Kishan sizes up this hip-high delivery and pulls it fiercely over midwicket for another boundary
overpitched and wide of off. Wrong line. Wrong length at the Wankhede. Kishan stretches out and thrashes it away between mid-off and extra-cover
Sisi pulls his length back, the line is on off, no room for Kishan this time to free his arms. Jabbed away to point
gives up a four first ball. On a length and angling across off, Kishan presses forward, opens the face and drives it nicely between cover and point
Rohit backs away even before Deshpande delivers. The bowler chases the moving away and beats his waft with another outswinger
good outswinger from Deshpande. He drags his length back and gets it to veer away past the outside edge
pumped over point, beats Dube to his right at deep third. On a length on off or on a fourth-stump line. Rohit aims to go over mid-off, but ends up carving it squarer
on a length and largely holds its line outside off, dinked to point
full inswinger, on the pads, Kishan can't get the flick away but they cross over for a leg bye
inswing for Deshpande but he can't control it. Leg-side wide. Dhoni dives across to his right to collect the ball
back of a length and skipping away outside off, decent bounce for Deshpande. Kishan opens the face and dabs it to point
Chahar is go to go now. Pitched-up delivery outside off, Rohit goes after it and slices it over mid-off
inswinger, finishes on the pads, tucked away through square leg
full inswinger from Chahar, veers in, takes the inside edge and rolls down to Magala at long leg
here comes Rohit: he dashes out of the crease, meets a full ball from Chahar early and pumps it over extra-cover. Takes it from the stumps and hits over the top
full outswinger outside off, a bit of early movement for Chahar. Ignored by Rohit
back of a length and slanting in on the stumps, worked to midwicket with the inward angle
That's that! In the slot outside off, Rayudu spanks him to the left of long-off and Chennai win by seven wickets and 11 balls to spare.
Ooh,  gets his radar wrong, horribly. Full-length ball outside off, he sprays it well past the tramline. That was so close to being called a no-ball. It was that wide.
Shin-high full toss on middle and leg, that is worked away to long-on by Gaikwad.
Another slower length ball outside off, he skips down the track looking to flay it away. Skews off the outside half of his blade to deep point.
Slower length ball on off, he hacks it back to the bowler
In the slot on middle, he dances down the track again and lofts over the bowler's head. Did not get all of it, did Rayudu but collects two.
A bit fortuitous but Rayudu will take it. Length ball that straightens on Rayudu just a touch on middle and leg. He closes the face of the blade early and the thick edge races past short third.
Banged in short, and that is a too short and goes over Rayudu's head. Called a wide.
Low full toss outside off, he jumps down the track and pummels him through covers
Dances down the track reaching the pitch of the ball and scythes him to long off. Six off the over.
A touch slower and shorter on off, he goes back and bunts it to long-on
Fuller on off, pushed down to long off for a single
A touch short outside off, he cuts it hard but straight to point. A bit of a misfield and they take a run.
Length outside off, he times it nicely to long off.
Flatter outside off, he goes back and pushes to extra cover
Wrong'un on middle, he goes well back and punches it hard to extra cover
Jumps down the track and accounts for the spin as he reaches the pitch of the ball to drive to long off.
Another googly on off, he defends it meekly towards cover
Wrong'un on off, don't think Rayudu spotted that. He pats it back to Chawla.
Fuller on off, driven back to the bowler.
Flipper on off, that does Rayudu all ends up. He was lucky to get his bat down in time and gets a thick inside edge back onto his pads.
just a touch short outside off and Gaikwad is so quick to go back and cut it hard to the left of cover.
Length outside off, he pats to point.
A rank full toss for Gaikwad, who accepts the gift gleefully. Tries the back of a hand delivery, which goes horribly wrong. Gaikwad whacks him over cow corner.
Lobs it prodigiously does Kartikeya outside off, he drives to long off

Another chop-on and Dube is a goner! Gets that length ball to skid quickly off the surface, angling into the batter. He stays back looking for a cut, but the ball is quite close to his body. Ends up inside-edging back onto his stumps. Celebrates in his own style, does Kartikeya.
A hint of turn as he slows it up on middle and turning away from Dube. Defends it.
Flatter outside off, he goes back and mistimes his punch to extra cover.
Long hop and Gaikwad does not miss out! Flatter, angled outside off. He stays back and pulls him in the gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket.
A touch slower on middle, he taps it towards covers and sets off for a run
Flatter outside off going away with the angle. Gaikwad slaps it to deep midwicket.
A touch short on middle and leg, he helps it to the left of deep backward square leg
Frees his arms and spanks Shokeen up and over long-on! Tossed up on middle. He does not bother reaching the pitch of it. Extends his arms and deposits it a few rows back
Good length ball on the pads of Dube who works him to deep midwicket.
Ah, gets that rip and turn. Was much slower on middle. He is cramped for room and can only bunt it back to the bowler
Fuller on off, he gets forward and knocks the ball to long off
Flat and short outside off, he whacks it off the backfoot past the bowler
Good length ball that was flatter on off, he romps back and whisks it to wide long on
Tossed up on off, he lobs it uppishly closer to extra cover
Just a touch short again outside off, he is back and across and tonks the slap but straight to mid-off.
Ooh, he was lining him up again. Shokeen sees him and gets that closer to the batter on leg stump. Dube checks his shot and defends back to the bowler.
Short and he finds the gap! Gets the length wrong does Shokeen with the ball on off. He goes back and slams the pull past deep midwicket.
A touch slower now on middle and leg, he defends it to short midwicket.
Another flattish ball on off, he stays back and bunts it to long-on
Flatter good length ball outside off, he goes back and slaps it to long off.
Another length ball outside off from Green that is met by a solid punch from Dube to long off.
Full on the stumps as Gaikwad presents the full face of his bat and gets it down to long-on.
Length ball on off, he stays legside of the ball and dinks it to long-off. The 100 comes up for CSK in 10.4 overs.
Full-length ball on off, he miscues his drive to short extra cover
Length ball now on middle, probably surprised Dube who was eyeing the short ball again. Does not move his foot as much and pushes towards extra cover.
Bangs the short ball that is around shoulder-high for Dube. He pulls it down and to the right of wide long on.
He is exclusively bowling googlies to Dube. That was a on a length on middle, he pushes it to long-on.
slightly short outside off, he goes back and cuts it to deep point
Googly again, but that was right in Gaikwad's arc. He gets forward and climbs all over it. Laces the covers drive with some finesse.
short and wide away from his reach and he muscles the pull to deep point
Fuller wrong'un outside off, he pushes down the ground where extra cover runs across and intercepts wonderfully
HAMMERS IT! On a length on off, Dube swings at it hard, flat past Chawla. Mid-on was straight, not straight enough.
Another bouncer, but this one does not rise as much as Dube nails the pull to deep midwicket.
Flat bats the bouncer close to mid-on and luckily for him, he did not get enough bat on it. Falls short of the fielder.

Attempted bouncer around shoulder-high. He mistimes his pull to the right of deep midwicket, and some excellent running gets them two. A better throw might have had Dube in a bit of trouble. But the throw was quite high.
Hard length on off as Dube stays legside of it and punches to extra cover
Gets the length ball to rise just outside off. Gaikwad stands tall and pats to deep third for a run.
Length down leg as Green raps Gaikwad on the pads but the ball was heading down leg. Trickles to the keeper.

Oh, he has flogged that straight to long-on!  A hint of turn for Chawla on the length ball outside off. Seems like the ball came a touch slower to Rahane, who was looking to loft it much straighter. Gets it off the bottom of the blade and Suryakumar Yadav makes no mistake coming in.
Fuller outside off defended to covers
Oh, this is sublime. All class! Legbreak on off, he gets across by using his feet and just places it in the gap to the left of deepmidwicket. Not once did he try to hit that hard.
Length again on middle stump, was a bit quicker. Gaikwad goes back and flicks it uppishly but there are no fielders inside the circle in front of square. Goes to long off.
A touch fuller on middle and leg, and that is whisked away in the gap to the right of long-on for a couple of runs.
Slower length ball on middle and leg, was about 80kph. The batter works him to the on-side with soft hands
That was once again fired in quick and full on middle and leg, he clips it deep backward square leg.
A touch slower now on off, 86kph, he opens the face of the bat a touch to get it to deep point.
Flat on middle and leg, he works it to short fine leg.
A tad short on middle and leg, he works it to wide long-on
Short and on the pads of the batter, who hacks the pull to deep backward square leg where the fielder makes a terrific stop to his left.
Flatter outside off, he pushes him to long off first up
Flatter outside off, he scythes it to long off.
In the aiiir, just falls short of a diving Tim David running in from long off. Another googly on off, he mistimes his loft but David can't come in quickly enough.
On a length on middle, he works it to the on-side for a run
Fastest half-century in IPL 2023 goes to Rahane!  Who would have thunk! Long hop, he goes back and hammers the pull through deep midwicket. Rahane's first IPL fifty since 2020.
Uppish but in the gap! What batting this by the opener on CSK debut. Wrong'un outside off, that is picked early. He drives through covers.
Flatter on off, he pushes it to long off for a run.
Fuller on the pads of Gaikwad who flicks it to deep midwicket
On a length right on off stump. He gets across and defends it solidly.
Full but well down leg, he looks to whisk it away, but misses. Called a wide.
On a length now just outside off, he pushes to deep point with an open face of the blade.

Rahane is in hurry today! No one is getting spared. Green gets the back of a length ball on the hips of Rahane, who pulls it over deep midwicket. The 50 of the partnership is up as well in quick time.
back of a length ball that shapes back into the batter, who is cramped for room but still gets it down to deep third.
Good length ball outside off, he pushes it to covers and sets off for a run.
Back of a length ball, was slightly slower outside off. He pats it to point and they take off for a run.

Oh, my word! Five boundaries in a row. Full, in the slot for Rahane who prods and plays the most perfect straight drive past the bowler and past mid-off. Sachin Tendulkar, in the Mumbai dugout would have been proud of that.
Oh, stop it Rahane!  Short and asking to be hit outside off. He lines up the cut and scorches it past cover. The ball races away across the turf.
So, what does Rahane do now? He waits for the back of a length ball outside off, and deftly taps it past short third  for a four. That is just toying with the youngster.
Short, wide, four! Arshad isn't on the money yet and Rahane is laying into him. Shapes up for the cut and hacks it through point.
BANG! Too easy for Rahane, but that's a horrible line. Full-length ball swinging down leg. Rahane gets that bottom-hand into play and just helps it over deep fine leg.
Back of a length ball on and around off stump as he stands tall and punches to mid-off.
Banged in short outside off, he sways outside the line of it
Ooh, another inside-edge back onto his pads, but Gaikwad was alive to the run and makes it easily despite the ball going close to the stumps.
Gets the length wrong and Rahane obliges. Back of a length ball on the hips of Rahane, who swivels and pulls the bowler over deep fine leg. That's a top shot.
Another back of a length ball that hits Rahane on the thigh pads with the ball lobbing close to the keeper
Ah, a misfield at extra cover now!  Not what you want. Back of a length ball outside off, he pushes hard to the fielder who makes a meal of it and concedes two.

Now, he gets his line on point and has the batter in trouble right away! On a length as he brings the ball back into Gaikwad, who is caught on the crease. Gets a thick inside-edge onto his pads. And that's what saved him
Full-length ball with the ball nipping back into Rahane. But the line is quite straight again and Rahane easily wrists him to deep backward square leg
Gets a hint of shape into the batter, but as has been the case with him all over, strays on the pads. Easily clipped to fine leg.
Goes for an expansive drive, and misses! Fuller outside off, he reaches for it, the ball was there, mid you. But is late into the drive.
Gets his radar wrong again. Tries to go fuller, but the line is wat outside the tramline outside off. Left alone and called a wide.
Length but the angle in on the pads again as Rahane flicks neatly to deep backward square leg.
On a length outside off, he pushes towards extra cover and sets off for a run. Rohit runs in but can't prevent the run.
Nope, sprays the full-length ball down leg first up. There was a hint of swing but the ball was heading way down leg.
Strays down leg, down as Rahane looks for a fine tickle, instead the ball catches his thigh pad and races away to the fence. Kishan gives chase, but isn't quick enough.
Back of a length ball outside off, he pushes solidly through point for a couple of runs first ball. Didn't try to over-hit it.

Chopped-on and Mumbai Indians have struck early! Just what the hosts would have needed. A little bit late on the back of a length ball just outside off. He pushes at it tentatively and ends up inside-edging the ball back onto his stumps. That will get the crowd going.
Cuts in him in half as Conway looks to play the pull to the short of a length ball on middle. He misses again with the ball not bouncing as much.
Ooh, play and a miss! Nice shape away from the batter, who pokes at it and the ball misses the outside edge by a whisker.
A hint of swing away from the batter, who gets across and shoulders arms. The bowler loses his footing in his followthrough.
